# 1 Enoch Chapter 74 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn-astr (Aramaic) | **Section:** Astronomical Book (Book of Luminaries)

---

**74:1** And-I-saw another-course, a-law for-her, [and-how] according-to that-law she-performs her-monthly-revolution.

**74:2** And-all these-Uriel, the-holy angel who-is the-leader of-them-all, showed me, and-their-positions, and-I-wrote-down their-positions as-he-showed-them to-me, and-I-wrote-down their-months as-they-were, and-the-appearance of-their-lights till-fifteen-days were-accomplished.

**74:3** In-single-seventh parts she-accomplishes all her-light in-the-east, and-in-single-seventh parts she-accomplishes all her-darkness in-the-west.

**74:4** And-in-certain-months she-alters her-settings, and-in-certain-months she-pursues her-own-peculiar-course.

**74:5** In-two-months the-moon-sets with-the-sun in-those-two-portals which-are in-the-middle, the-third and-the-fourth.

**74:6** She-goes-forth for-seven-days, and-turns-about and-returns again through-the-portal where-the-sun-rises, and-accomplishes all her-light: and-she-recedes from-the-sun, and-in-eight-days enters the-sixth portal from-which the-sun-goes-forth.

**74:7** And-when the-sun-goes-forth from-the-fourth portal, she-goes-forth seven-days, until-she-goes-forth from-the-fifth and-turns-back again in-seven-days into-the-fourth portal and-accomplishes all her-light, and-recedes and-enters by-the-first portal in-eight-days.

**74:8** And-she-returns again in-seven-days into-the-fourth portal from-which the-sun-goes-forth.

**74:9** Thus-I-saw their-position — how the-moons rose and-the-sun set in-those-days.

**74:10** And-if-five-years are-added-together, the-sun-has-an-excess of-thirty-days; and-all the-days which-accrue to-one-of-those-five-years when-they-are-full, amount-to three-hundred-and-sixty-four-days.

**74:11** And-the-excess of-the-sun and-of-the-stars amounts-to six-days; in-five-years six-days every-year, which-amounts-to thirty-days; and-the-moon-falls-behind the-sun and-the-stars by-thirty-days.

**74:12** And-the-sun and-the-stars bring-in all the-years exactly, so-that they-advance-not a-single-day forward or-backward, but-change the-year with-exact-justice in-three-hundred-and-sixty-four-days.

**74:13** In-three-years there-are-one-thousand-and-ninety-two-days, and-in-five-years one-thousand-eight-hundred-and-twenty-days, so-that-in-eight-years there-are-two-thousand-nine-hundred-and-twelve-days.

**74:14** For-the-moon alone the-days amount-in-three-years to-one-thousand-and-sixty-two-days; and-in-five-years she-falls-behind-fifty-days: [i.e., to-the-sum (of one-thousand-seven-hundred-and-seventy-days), it-is-necessary to-add (sixty-two-days), i.e. eight-days.]

**74:15** And-in-five-years there-are-one-thousand-seven-hundred-and-seventy-days, so-that-for-the-moon the-days in-eight-years amount-to-two-thousand-eight-hundred-and-thirty-two-days.

**74:16** [For-in-eight-years she-falls-behind-eighty-days], all-the-days she-falls-behind in-eight-years are-eighty.

**74:17** And-the-year is-accurately completed in-conformity with-their-world-stations and-the-stations of-the-sun, which-rise from-the-portals through-which it-rises and-sets-thirty-days.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Chapter 74 gives the mathematical discrepancy between the solar year (364 days) and the lunar year (354 days) — a difference of 10 days per year, 30 days per 3 years, and 80 days per 8 years. This is the calendrical polemic at the heart of the Astronomical Book.*
